source_text.body:
Monitor calls, texts and emails and send voice memos on urgent items
The poster uses Grok Bot by voice to watch calls, texts and forwarded emails for new jobs and urgent items and send a voice memo, and uses a multi-agent setup for government bureaucracy.
·
Nov 17, 2026
Done with
GB
Grok Bot
What they did
One poster said Grok Bot watches their calls, texts, and forwarded emails for new jobs or urgent items and sends a voice memo when something needs attention. They run two bots, one dedicated to the rental platform and one for everything else; when a new offer appears, they can say "accept it," and the bot pulls access info and photos, builds the job in Housecall Pro, and drafts reschedules, estimates, and invoices for approval.
How it went
They said it is taking real work off their plate every day, but browser actions can be slow and they had to set many rules. A separate commenter using a multi-agent setup at a government job said an "office boss" agent handles morning triage, regulation checks, draft replies, and task-board updates, and called it a massive time saver.
Worth knowing
Nothing was allowed to go out or be changed without the poster's approval, and getting that approval gate working took setup.
Try it yourself
with
Grok Bot
Copy prompt
Watch my [phone calls, texts and forwarded emails at address] for new job requests and urgent items such as [what counts as urgent for me]. When something urgent comes in, send me a short voice memo with who it is from, what they need and a suggested next step. Log non-urgent new jobs in [sheet or app] and do not reply to anyone on my behalf without asking me first.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/GrokBot/comments/1xy5drz/looking_for_people_automating_their_work_with
